title: Baby Eyes Soul Fix
description: Baby mobs are not marketable plushies! This resource pack adds back whites to the eyes of baby mobs that had them before.
body:
# Please don't turn me into a marketable plushie!!!

_Babies Have Souls!_ breathes life into our poor baby mobs by adding the whites back to their eyes and touching up textures of the animals that already had solid black eyes. For some reason (plushification [this is a very real term]), Mojang decided to make babies look like lifeless statues so I decided to revert that. I added whites back to the eyes of all the mobs that had them before except for a couple that I thought were well executed like the turtle and of course the chick. For some reason mojang removed the eyebrows on polar bears, llamas, and foxes so I added those back too.

![Comparison of the two black cat textures with/without the pack enabled.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e4822f3ad789c770764840a2e78ef3d675c0fc3.png)

### Compatibility:

I am currently working on adding compatibility for resource packs that backport the 26.1 baby models to older versions of the game.

### Planned Features:

- Shrinking the baby zombie head slightly

- Adding back the parts of the baby villiager head that Mojang sliced off

- Fixing whatever is going on with baby horse heads right now



Please join my Discord server to request additions and report bugs, and visit this link to see some of my other projects!
https://modrinth.com/user/Chardavius_
